description: Daily fingerprints of the Tideline ledger evidence bundle. Each manifest_sha256 is timestamped by RFC 3161 time-stamping authorities and submitted to OpenTimestamps. The manifests and ledgers themselves are private; these receipts prove each fingerprint existed no later than its timestamp.
how_to_verify: Decode tsr_base64 to a file and run: openssl ts -verify -digest <manifest_sha256> -in reply.tsr -CAfile <your trusted root bundle>. Expect "Verification: OK".
